title: EIP-1967 beacon slot
detects: A non-zero value points to a beacon contract. The beacon holds the implementation address for potentially many proxies at once.
knownFalseNegative: Finding a beacon is only the first hop. The upgrade authority lives on the BEACON, not on the token, so stopping here understates who can change the code.
rationale: Beacon proxies let one address upgrade many tokens simultaneously, which is a larger blast radius than a single proxy.
